Given your double vision, upper limb weakness, and difficulty climbing stairs, have you noticed any numbness or tingling in your hands or feet, or any issues with balance and coordination? speaker: Patient
text: I have not had trouble swallowing or slurred speech. I also have not noticed breathing difficulty, and the symptoms started gradually about a month ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis (MS) with brainstem involvement and cerebellar ataxia. The absence of sensory symptoms like numbness, combined with the chronic gradual onset and normal CK/EMG, points strongly toward a central demyelinating process rather than a muscular or peripheral nerve issue. Please review the MRI images to confirm the presence of white matter plaques.
